facts.text: Živí se létajícím hmyzem, který chytá za letu.
facts.quote: Their diet consists of flying insects that are caught on the wing.
These birds spend most of their lives in the air.

facts.text: Často se krmí ve velkých hejnech spolu s vlaštovkami a jinými rorýsy.
facts.quote: They often feed in large flocks with other species of swiftlet and swallow.

facts.text: Používá echolokaci, aby v temnotě jeskyní našel místo k hnízdění.
facts.quote: They also emit a rattling call used for echolocation, which enables them to look for their nesting sites in the darkness of caves.

facts.text: Hnízdo si staví výhradně ze ztuhlých slin.
facts.quote: Its opaque and whitish nest is made exclusively of solidified saliva
Two white, oval, non-glossy eggs are laid.
